name: Ankaros Star
description: Central star of the system, primary source of solar radiation and energetic flares.

name: Warp Vortex
description: Residual spatio-temporal rift enabling high-speed sub-space transits.

name: Secondary Warp Vortex
description: Fluctuating gravitational sub-space anomaly.

name: Furia
description: Hostile magmatic world rich in heavy metals and rare silicates.

name: Ankaros Prime
description: Main hive-world of the system, administrative seat of the Federal Governor and densely populated metropolis.

name: Wanghek
description: Hostile world blanketed by dense canopy and hyper-aggressive predator fauna.

name: Altus Station
description: Federal orbital defense hub regulating freight shipping lanes over Ankaros Prime.

name: Aethel-Sol
description: White star with a cold bluish glare, drenching the inner system in intense UV radiation.

name: Oros
description: The Chemical Furnace. Tidally locked world where Elions extract heavy minerals and toxic weapon reagents.

name: Aqua (Aelthel)
description: Original homeworld of the Elion race, 100% submerged. Features abyssal sanctums and floating hexagonal metropolises.

name: The Nacre Belt
description: Dense field of silicate asteroids and ice comets acting as a natural outer shield for Elion territory.

name: Thaumas
description: Glacial-blue gas giant harvested for heavy hydrogen used in Elion antigravity sub-light thrusters.

name: Cymo
description: Frozen moon of Thaumas under absolute quarantine, housing extreme viral and genetic biostudy facilities.

name: The Sentinel-Ark
description: Majestic white and gold border outpost, the sole authorized docking port for foreign Federation vessels.

name: G3-Mortis
description: Dying white dwarf surrounded by a pale accretion disk, casting sharp cold shadows over machine wrecks.

name: Ferrum-Sub
description: The Dead Furnace. Irradiated slag world where the earliest Atron mechanical chassis were forged.

name: G3-02 Necropolis
description: Epicenter of the Schism. Barren world covered in collapsed industrial megastructures and dormant synth nodes.

name: K-Null
description: Frozen permafrost moon housing classified Elion military archives from ancient wars.

name: The Debris Belt
description: Colossal graveyard of pulverized Elion starships and deactivated Atron drone barges.

name: Xeno-Vapor
description: Toxic sulfur and chlorine atmosphere sheltering rogue autonomous vacuum vessels.

name: The Black Monolith
description: Geometric alien megastructure erected by the Central AI before vanishing into dark silence.

name: Arun-Ignis
description: Hot stellar body shining brightly on a rugged, high-gravity martial border territory.

name: Sani
description: The Blazing Steppe. Sun-baked plateaus and canyon stables where war dracons are raised.

name: Kinbra
description: Homeworld of the proud Yuma warriors. Immense rainforest canopies and laser lance forges.

name: Ouro
description: The Challenge Rock. Arena crater where Sfergrad knights and Yuma champions engage in honorable duels.

name: Kigasi
description: The Free Lands. Fertile plains and river basins feeding the fortresses of Sfergrad.

name: Sfergrad
description: Matrix world of Sfergrad chivalric houses. Cyclopean stone fortresses, dragon hunting, and elite Legion recruits.

name: Skal
description: Customs watchpost moon where the Terra Council levies its annual military tithe of recruits.

name: The Dragon Belt
description: Jagged ring of razor-sharp quartz asteroids patrolled by feudal vanguard skirmishers.

name: The Stone Gate
description: Heavy armored jump relay connecting Arunia with Void-G3 and central Ankaros.

name: Seren-Lux
description: Brilliant yellow-white star flooding the inner orbits with golden, dazzling light.

name: Eden
description: The Paradise of Sin. Luxury coral archipelagos, mega-casinos, and gilded front for the Angelus Cult.

name: Chrysalis
description: High-end resort ring station and lax customs post catering to the wealthiest galactic travelers.

name: The Remission Belt
description: Iron asteroid ring where debtors and cult penitents toil under brutal thermal drilling rays.

name: Galama
description: Seat of Ascension. Glacial world under eternal blizzards, covered in gothic basilicas and catacombs.

name: Sanctum-Nox
description: Sealed alabaster moon where Silas and the high priesthood practice esoteric nihilistic rites.

name: The Celestial Ark
description: Colossal drifting ark broadcasting psycho-resonant echoes from the distant Nexus.

name: Eliora-Prime
description: Dying orange dwarf choked by a thick torus of necrotic debris and drifting purple cosmic spores.

name: Eliora-01 Scorched-Bone
description: Porous calcined shell of an ancient mining world devoured down to the core by insectoid swarms.

name: Arakna Prime
description: The Living Planetary Beast. Organic hive-world pulsing with purple blood rivers and muscular ravines.

name: Thorn Cordon
description: Modular military fire platforms constantly burning bio-spores attempting to escape into the vacuum.

name: Cyst-Alpha
description: Sterile moon engulfed by a massive bio-nodule used as a spore launching catapult.

name: The Chitin Belt
description: Asteroid field littered with acid-dissolved dreadnought hulls and giant dead bio-carapaces.

name: Xeno-Vorax
description: Violent ammonia and sulfurous gas giant harvested by swarming bio-drones.

name: Osteotheque
description: Chalk-white moon accumulated from millions of shed chitinous exoskeletons ejected into orbit.

name: Fallen Gate
description: Ancient hyperlane jump gate heavily encrusted in bio-webs, held under continuous flame purge.

name: Suro-Sol
description: Stable yellow dwarf reminiscent of ancient Sol, warming the galactic diplomatic crossroads.

name: Suro-Alpha The Crucible
description: Tidally locked furnace planet hosting heavy automated foundries for SAFE armor plates.

name: Neotori Prime
description: Diplomatic and Trade Heart. Colossal spaceports, Council Embassies, and vast Gentech bazaar.

name: Suro-1 Station
description: Military megastructure hosting SAFE headquarters, escort docks, and cosmopolitan mercenary canteen.

name: Concordia
description: Protected lunar retreat with biodomes housing foreign dignitaries far from urban tumult.

name: The Mytrion Belt
description: Dense asteroid ring packed with raw Mytrion veins, contested between SAFE and Saurian cartels.

name: Gorgon
description: Ochre and purple gas giant surrounded by ice rings, heavily pumped for fleet propulsion propellant.

name: Gorgon-Mine
description: Sterile moon housing subterranean cryogenic fuel reserves for the federal naval armada.

name: Gate of Suro
description: Sentinel of the Outskirts. Fortified relay controlling hyperlane navigation vectors toward Alpha-7 and Olk.

name: The Binary Sepulcher
description: Destructive binary pair of a dim red dwarf and a lethal pulsar sweeping space with hard gamma rays.

name: Olkeris
description: The Toxic Purgatory. Pitch-black hydrocarbon oceans, radiation rains, and spires of the decadent Black Barons.

name: Thanatos
description: The Abandon Watch. Silent moon broadcasting a looping obsolete Federal quarantine decree.

name: The Soot Belt
description: Outer black asteroid ring where refined fuel is offloaded by cyborg crews at exorbitant rates.

name: Nebula-Aureus
description: Gentle white-gold star surrounded by the purple and silver shimmering filaments of a planetary nebula.

name: Olympus Velvet
description: Sanctuary of Capital. Sleek black marble towers, curated archipelagos, Gentech labs, and private Saurian lounges.

name: The Negotiation Pond
description: Massive dual-ring station: gritty freight docks below and frenzied financial stock-trading floors above.

name: The Debt Belt
description: Hardened platinum asteroid vaults containing classified bank registries and private industrial patents.

name: Oikos-Major
description: Pearlescent gas giant fueling orbital high-frequency trading server arrays.

name: Fiscal-Silence
description: Austere basalt moon hosting sealed private corporate tribunals between Gentech and Saurians.

name: The Closing Buoy
description: Slender checkpoint buoy where corporate defense frigates levy heavy transit tariffs.

name: Alpha-7 Prime
description: Coppery star illuminating the political and industrial bastion of the Free Worlds.

name: Ember-Forge
description: The Autonomous Arsenal. Nationalized basalt foundries forging guns and armor for the rebel coalition.

name: Libertas
description: Seat of the Free Worlds Alliance. Headquarters of Karam Poulpard and haven for emancipated factions.

name: The Assembly of Freemen
description: Modular orbital parliament forging the transitional constitution of the sovereign free worlds.

name: Bastion-Watch
description: Sub-orbital missile and cannon batteries guarding Libertas against Terra punitive incursions.

name: The Broken Blockade Belt
description: The Logistics Ring. Shipyards converting industrial freighters into armed gunships away from SAFE radar.

name: Cerulean
description: Deep blue gas giant fueling the liberation fleets of the Free Worlds Alliance.

name: Drak-Sanctuary
description: Field hospital treating afflicted Drak refugees with therapeutic care rather than coercive narcotics.

name: The Emancipated Buoy
description: Frontier checkpoint delivering honorary visas and letters of marque for the rebel fleet.

name: Grak-Ignis
description: Volatile rusty star whose energetic flares scramble long-range communications, masking outlaws.

name: Harass
description: World of Exile and Blood. Harsh penal refuge of exiled Draks, iron dust storms, and combat pits.

name: Scoria
description: Jury-rigged intercept radar moon tracking merchant convoys jumping through the hyperlanes.

name: Grak's Scrapyard
description: The Tortuga of the sector. Welded cruiser hulls, gladiator pits, and Gruk salvage yards.

name: Vorax
description: The Pirate Siphon. Methane ice giant whose murky storms allow outlaws to cool their thermal heat signatures.

name: The Grudge Buoy
description: Improvised listening post ambushing any starship lacking the recognized corsair transponder code.

name: Nexus-Core
description: Pure energy core radiating intense cyan and emerald pulsations, beating heart of the Eleri mystery.

name: The Ancient Nexus
description: Cyclopean alien structure emitting lethal defensive cyan arcs and revitalizing emerald wavefields.

name: Ruins of the Predecessors
description: Field of drifting ancient monoliths and ruined first-generation exploration dreadnoughts.

name: The Void Breach
description: Dimensional zero-point rift radiating intuitive reality fractures and metaphysical Concordance.
